args.text:
---
name: Active users
description: Users seen in the last N days
database: postgres
tags: [users, weekly]
parameters:
  - name: days
    type: number
    default: 30
    description: How far back
  - name: region
    type: text
---
SELECT * FROM users
WHERE seen_at > now() - {{days}} * interval '1 day'
  AND region = {{region}};

output.name: Active users
output.description: Users seen in the last N days
